lessons.finding: Explicit authenticated profile metadata, single dispatch, fixed legacy/V1 vectors, unknown-profile failure, opt-in generation, and preserved legacy defaults form the reusable baseline.
Additive schema/API metadata and rollback-by-stopping-new-generation must be adapted to each container boundary.
Receipt version, unsigned-body boundary, and signature placement do not generalize to component containers.
Profile, algorithm, type/path, and payload must be bound when attacker-removable metadata could otherwise select a valid legacy interpretation.
Per-child mixed profiles are safe only when every child dispatch is explicit and the parent does not infer a profile.
The Core ResearchBundle root remains sorted path:digest framing; this does not authorize other roots or chains.

unknownResolution.reason: Sprint 4 recomputes package hashes, while Sprint 5 mixes placeholder signatures, opaque invitation tokens, event-manifest hashes, length-only checks, and unknown external readers. No single durable identity contract or archival policy is evidenced.

remainingCandidates.reason: Extends the proven child migration to a dynamic multi-instance path family while keeping the root algorithm, SDKs, and all other components unchanged. Explicit V1 opt-in fails closed for unsupported Run values.
Volume mounts fit V1, but the stored fixturesMerkleRoot is not currently recomputed during verification and the manifest has no per-digest profile metadata.

Python emits snake_case dataclass dictionaries while TypeScript emits product objects; APIs accept broad payloads and roots preserve input order. Product-equivalence and container semantics are not yet bounded.
The bounded unsigned creation record fits V1, but no verifier recomputes provenanceHash and no profile field exists. It adds less architectural learning than a second root-bearing child.
Ordinary assertion weights are floating point. Narrowing or coercing them would change benchmark semantics or the V1 numeric contract.
Precomputed artifacts and arbitrary trace payloads feed one root and seal, while seal verification remains incomplete.
Public string-versus-object behavior and possible persisted artifact IDs require an external compatibility plan.
Node changes cascade through graph root and lineage seal; model temperature is outside V1 and the seal is not fully verified.
The commitment contains floating thresholds and gates later execution matching and evidence eligibility.
A predecessor change rewrites every successor identity; neither chain has a versioned transition boundary.
No common durable identity contract or complete consumer/history inventory is evidenced.

selectionContract.surface: Core ResearchBundle runs/<run.id>.json component identities only
selectionContract.currentIdentitySemantics: The Core builder serializes each Run with legacy TypeScript canonicalJson, hashes those stored UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256, records path and digest, and feeds path:digest into the sorted root.
selectionContract.currentHash: sha256 over stored legacy component bytes
selectionContract.profileBinding: Profile and algorithm are inside the V1 canonicalized preimage.
selectionContract.pathTypeBinding: The literal runs/<run.id>.json path and research-bundle-run type are inside the preimage.
selectionContract.profileMetadataLocation: Optional canonicalization metadata on each run BundleComponentArtifact and includedArtifacts entry.
selectionContract.legacyIdentification: ResearchBundle schema version 1.0.0 run entries without canonicalization metadata are legacy-typescript-v0 only.
selectionContract.legacyVerification: Recompute SHA-256 from the stored run JSON with the existing legacy path; never probe V1.
selectionContract.newGeneration: An additive explicit builder option requests V1 for run components; omission remains byte-identical legacy. Unsupported V1 values fail before emission.
selectionContract.downgradeProtection: Removing metadata selects the single legacy calculation, which cannot match the profile/algorithm/type/path/payload-bound V1 digest.
selectionContract.unknownProfileFailure: Reject unknown, empty, extra, malformed, or unsupported metadata before hashing.
selectionContract.mixedProfileRule: Legacy and V1 run entries and other legacy components may coexist only because every V1 child is self-identifying and the root hashes recorded path:digest values without profile inference.
selectionContract.parentRootDependency: New opted-in run digests change new bundle root values; the sorted pipe-joined path:digest root algorithm does not change.
selectionContract.historicalPolicy: Never rewrite, rehash, relabel, or add metadata to an existing bundle.
selectionContract.rollback: Stop new run V1 generation while retaining V1 and bounded legacy verification.
selectionContract.versionImpact: No schema, package, release, or tag version change is required for planning; implementation may use a release-neutral changeset.
doNotTouch: evaluation and all other ResearchBundle component hashes

threatModel.metadataStripping: Must fail because metadata is identity-bound.
threatModel.profileSubstitution: Must fail before or during the one selected digest calculation.
threatModel.algorithmSubstitution: Only sha256 is accepted and bound.
threatModel.payloadReplay: Payload replay at a different path fails path binding.
threatModel.crossTypeReplay: A workspace/evaluation payload cannot verify as a run because componentType is bound.
threatModel.pathReplay: A run digest cannot move between run IDs because the full literal path is bound.
threatModel.downgrade: Missing metadata selects legacy once; no profile probing follows.
threatModel.malformedProfile: Malformed, extra, empty, or partial metadata fails closed before hashing.
threatModel.legacyV1Confusion: Artifact version does not imply V1; only validated per-child metadata selects V1.
threatModel.mixedProfileConfusion: Each child dispatches independently; unresolved child categories remain legacy.
threatModel.parentRootConfusion: Root framing is unchanged and never used to infer child profile.
threatModel.hashCascade: Only new opted-in run digest and resulting new root value change.
threatModel.historicalReinterpretation: Existing bundles remain immutable legacy artifacts.
